title: ECCITE-seq
protocol: Obtain all single cell suspensions from different samples/conditions that will be multiplexed in the run.
Count all cells to ensure accurate quantitation.
Incubate cells for 10 minutes at 4°C with Fc Blocking reagent.
While cells are incubating, prepare antibody-pool using titrated amounts of each CITE-seq antibody and 1 µg of single cell hashing antibody (pool).
Add antibody-oligo pool to cells after incubation with Fc Block.
Incubate for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Wash cells three times with Staining buffer, spin 5 minutes at 300g at 4°C.
Resuspend cells in PBS and filter through 40 µm strainers.
Verify cell concentration by counting on hemocytometer after filtration.
Pool all different samples/conditions at desired proportions and immediately proceed to next step.
Run 10x Genomics single cell V(D)J assay according to manufacturer’s instructions with modifications.
Spike-in the guide RT primero at reverse transcription step: Add 5.9 µl of 2 µM gd_RT_v4 primer in the RT reaction (0.12 µM final concentration).
Subtract that volume from the water added to the cells.
At cDNA amplification step: Spike-in additive primers to increase yield of applicable tag products.
Add 1 µl of 2 µM protein-tag additive.
Add 1 µl of 1 µM hashtag additive.
Add 1 µl of 1 µM guide-tag additive.
After cDNA amplification: Perform 0.6x SPRI selection to separate protein and guide tags from full-length cDNAs.
Do not discard supernatant from 0.6x SPRI; it contains the ADTs and hashtags.
Add 0.6x SPRI to cDNA reaction as described in 10x Genomics or Drop-seq protocol.
Incubate 5 minutes and place on magnet.
Supernatant contains ADTs and hashtags.
Beads contain full length mRNA-derived cDNAs.
Proceed with standard 10x V(D)J solution for cDNA sequencing library preparation.
Add 1.4x SPRI to supernatant to obtain a final volume of 2x SPRI.
Transfer entire volume into a low-bind 1.5mL tube and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Place tube on magnet; wait until solution is clear.
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Add 400 µl 80% Ethanol to the tube without disturbing the pellet; stand for 30 seconds.
Carefully remove and discard the ethanol wash.
Centrifuge tube briefly and return it to magnet.
Remove and discard any remaining ethanol.
Resuspend in beads using 50 µl water.
Add 100 µl SPRI reagent directly onto resuspended beads.
Mix by pipetting; incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Place tube on magnet; wait until solution is clear.
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Add 200 µl 80% Ethanol to the tube without disturbing the pellet; stand for 30 seconds.
Carefully remove and discard the ethanol wash.
Repeat wash.
Centrifuge tube briefly and return it to magnet.
Remove and discard any remaining ethanol.
Allow beads to air dry for 2 minutes.
Resuspend beads in 45 µl water for each element captured.
Pipette mix vigorously.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place tube on magnet.
Transfer clear supernatant into a new tube.
Mix 45 µl bead elution with 50 µl 2x KAPA Hifi PCR Master Mix, 2.5 µl 10 µM SI-PCR oligo, and 2.5 µl 10 µM TruSeq DNA D7xx_s primer.
Incubate at 95°C for 3 minutes.
Cycle through 95°C for 20 seconds, 64°C for 30 seconds, and 72°C for 20 seconds for ~8-12 cycles.
Hold at 72°C for 5 minutes.
Mix 45 µl bead elution with 50 µl 2x KAPA Hifi Master mix, 2.5 µl 10 µM SI-PCR oligo, and 2.5 µl 10 µM TruSeq Small RNA RPIx primer.
Incubate at 95°C for 3 minutes.
Cycle through 95°C for 20 seconds, 60°C for 30 seconds, and 72°C for 20 seconds for ~6-10 cycles.
Hold at 72°C for 5 minutes.
Mix 45 µl bead elution with 50 µl 2x KAPA Hifi Master mix, 2.5 µl 10 µM SI-PCR primer, and 2.5 µl 10 µM gd_add_v4 primer.
Incubate at 95°C for 3 minutes.
Cycle through 95°C for 20 seconds, 64°C for 30 seconds, and 72°C for 20 seconds for ~8-10 cycles.
Hold at 72°C for 5 minutes.
Purify all tag libraries using 1.6x SPRI purification by adding 160 µl SPRI reagent.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place tube on magnet and wait 1 minute until solution is clear.
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Add 200 µl 80% Ethanol to the tube without disturbing the pellet and stand for 30 seconds \(first Ethanol wash).
Carefully remove and discard the ethanol wash.
Add 200 µl 80% Ethanol to the tube without disturbing the pellet and stand for 30 seconds \(second Ethanol wash).
Carefully remove and discard the ethanol wash.
Centrifuge tube briefly and return it to magnet.
Remove and discard any remaining ethanol and allow the beads to air dry for 2 minutes.
Resuspend beads in 20 µl water.
Pipette mix vigorously and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place tube on magnet and transfer clear supernatant to PCR tube.

Proceed with indexing PCR for the guide-tag library using 100 µL reaction mixture containing bead elution, 50 µl of 2x KAPA Hifi Master mix, 2.5 µl of 10 µM SI-PCR primer, and 2.5 µl of 10 µM Next_nst_x primer.
Incubate at 95˚C for 3 minutes.
Cycle through the following steps: Incubate at 95˚C for 20 seconds, incubate at 54˚C for 30 seconds, and incubate at 72˚C for 20 seconds for approximately 6-10 cycles.
Incubate at 72˚C for 5 minutes.
Purify the library using 1.6x SPRI as described above.
Elute in 20 µl water.
Quantify all tag libraries by standard methods.
Prepare the TCR γ/δ library according to the 10x Genomics protocol for generating TCR α/β libraries, but substitute primers as detailed below:
For PCR1, use Human γ/δ mix 1 (R1_hTRDC + R1_hTRGC) instead of T cell 1 primer.
For PCR2, use Human γ/δ mix 2 (R2_hTRDC + R2_hTRGC) instead of T cell 2 primer.
Mix 2-5 μl full length cDNA with 2x KAPA Hifi Master mix, cDNA additive, SI-PCR primer, and human γ/δ mix 1 to a final volume of 100 μl for PCR1.
Mix 35 μl bead elution with 2x KAPA Hifi Master mix, cDNA additive, SI-PCR or P5 primer, and human γ/δ mix 2 to a final volume of 100 μl for PCR2.
Perform cleanups and PCRs according to the 10x protocol conditions, adjusting amplification cycles (~12) due to rarity of γ/δ T cells compared to α/β T cells.
Further process TCR γ/δ enriched libraries according to the 10x Genomics Single Cell V(D)J protocol.
Sequencing CITE-seq libraries:
Pool protein-tag, hashtag-, and guide-tag libraries with cDNA sequencing libraries at different proportions.
Sequence protein-tag libraries in 3-10% of a lane.
Sequence hashtag libraries in 2-5% of a lane.
Sequence guide-tag libraries in 5-10% of a lane.
